title: Valuation Desk Basis Note: Inspection and Condition Grading of a Traded Piece
content:
Every piece traded under the Belrose Trade-In and Upgrade Programmes is inspected and graded before any credit is issued, and the grade is recorded against the registration. A grade recorded by the appraiser stands over the customer's own description of the piece's condition, however carefully the customer described it.

## When an inspection may be logged

An inspection is logged only while the registration stands at registered, appraisal pending or credit issued. The standing is read from the registration itself, before the inspection is logged.

| Standing of the registration | Inspection may be logged |
|---|---|
| registered | yes |
| appraisal pending | yes |
| credit issued | yes |
| partially redeemed | no |
| redeemed, expired or revoked | no |

## Grades outside the programme

A piece graded outside the condition grades the programme accepts is refused, and the customer is offered the standard trade-in instead where that programme accepts the grade. Which grades each programme accepts, whether inspection is required, the deduction the programme publishes for each grade, the largest amount the chain answers for while the piece is in its care and whether the piece is shipped under insurance are the programme's published figures.

## Clause no longer in force

The following clause of this basis note is **no longer in force** and has been superseded by the current basis of valuation: "The valuation is reduced by the programme's deduction for the grade the piece was found at, and where the deduction is the whole of the valuation no credit is issued." The programme's published deduction figures by grade remain the programme's figures; only this handling clause is withdrawn.

## Points of judgement

- The customer describes the piece as excellent; the appraiser records it as good. The registration carries good.
- A piece is graded fair and offered under a programme that accepts only excellent and good. It is refused under that programme, and where the Belrose Standard Trade-In accepts fair, that programme is offered instead.
